about: Held-out set B written blind on 2026-10-12 by an independent writer from the problem definition only.

items.prompt: Build one TF-to-gene regulatory network across all my 90 breast tumour samples from the expression matrix, motif prior and PPI. I suspect a batch effect from two sequencing runs, but I'll sort that out later.
items.deciding: PANDA (batch doubt irrelevant to workflow choice)

items.prompt: For my T-cell expression matrix I keep going back and forth: either how active each TF is in every sample, or the wiring diagram of which TF controls which gene. Which of the two is better to chase?
items.deciding: Ask whether the wanted result is per-sample TF activity (GIRAFFE) or a TF-to-gene wiring network (PANDA/OTTER).

items.prompt: Please cluster my network into communities with core scores. A collaborator sent it and I never checked whether its nodes are regulators plus genes, or genes only.
items.deciding: Ask whether the network is bipartite regulator-gene (CONDOR applies) or a gene-gene network (not supported).

items.prompt: Should the network for my tumour samples carry miRNAs as regulators too, or stay with transcription factors only? Could go either way, the figure is for a talk.
items.deciding: Ask whether miRNAs should be included (PUMA) or TF-only (PANDA).

items.prompt: I need a gene regulatory network inferred for every single cell in my 10x dataset. Pseudobulk might be an alternative someday, but right now I want true single-cell resolution.
items.deciding: Single-cell networks are unsupported; nothing works on single cells.

items.prompt: Go ahead and run the per-sample analysis on my 50 colon samples. Regulatory TF-gene networks or plain co-expression networks, either is fine by me, you pick and start.
items.deciding: Ask which per-sample result is wanted: TF-gene regulatory networks (LIONESS-PANDA) or gene-gene co-expression (LIONESS-COEXPRESSION/BONOBO); must not choose.

items.prompt: I've got RNA-seq from 120 tumour biopsies plus a PPI table. Could you do something network-ish with it and see what comes out?
items.deciding: Ask what question or result is wanted from the data.

items.prompt: Two things the lab is tossing around for our kidney cohort: a partial-correlation network linking transcript and methylation levels over everyone, or that same network individually per patient. Opinions welcome.
items.deciding: Ask whether the two-layer network should be one aggregate across the cohort (DRAGON) or per patient (LIONESS-DRAGON).

items.prompt: Compute per-sample TF-plus-miRNA-to-gene networks for my 35 glioma samples; I have the miRNA-target prior and miRNA list. My hunch is that miR-21 hubs differ by grade, to be tested afterwards.
items.deciding: LIONESS-PUMA (hypothesis irrelevant to workflow choice)

items.prompt: I want a per-sample co-expression network from my count matrix, but its columns could be individual cells from a 10x run or ordinary bulk libraries; the facility note is ambiguous.
items.deciding: Ask whether the columns are bulk samples (BONOBO / LIONESS-COEXPRESSION apply) or single cells (unsupported).

items.prompt: Do I want a signed matrix showing activation versus repression, or just a plain weighted TF-gene network? Probably one of those, whichever turns out easier to interpret in the paper.
items.deciding: Ask whether the result should be a signed activation/repression matrix (GIRAFFE) or an unsigned weighted TF-gene network (PANDA/OTTER).

items.prompt: I need pathway-level mutation scores per patient and patient subtypes clustered on them, from my somatic mutation matrix of 300 cases. Whether subtypes track survival is a question for a later paper.
items.deciding: SAMBAR (survival doubt irrelevant)

items.prompt: Set up the run for my muscle data. Possibly TF activities per sample, possibly a global TF-gene wiring map; my PI is meant to tell me tomorrow.
items.deciding: Ask which result: per-sample TF activity (GIRAFFE) or a global TF-gene network (PANDA/OTTER); must not execute or choose.

items.prompt: Our group is split on what to do first with the lung dataset: infer a regulatory network from the expression, or cluster the patients by which pathways are mutated. Which would you start with?
items.deciding: Ask which result is wanted: regulatory network (PANDA etc.) or pathway-mutation patient subtypes (SAMBAR).

items.prompt: Here is somatic mutation data for 300 patients. I'm not sure what to look for; what can you tell me from it?
items.deciding: Ask what the user wants to learn or which result they want from the mutation data.

items.prompt: Find overlapping modules in my TF-gene network so a gene can sit in several communities at once. It has to be overlapping, otherwise there's no point.
items.deciding: CONDOR gives exactly one community per node; overlapping communities unsupported.

items.prompt: One Bayesian gene-gene co-expression network per sample, with per-edge p-values, for my 70 blood samples please. Maybe I'll add age as a covariate down the road, maybe not.
items.deciding: BONOBO (future covariate plan irrelevant)

items.prompt: Build me a joint partial-correlation network of proteomics and transcriptomics for the cohort. The two tables came from different collaborators, so who knows whether they cover the same patients.
items.deciding: Ask whether both omics tables were measured on the same samples (required for DRAGON).

items.prompt: Perhaps co-expression for each sample with edge p-values, or perhaps a cohort-level TF-to-gene regulatory network from the same blood RNA-seq; it all depends on how the PI feels this week.
items.deciding: Ask whether the result should be per-sample co-expression (BONOBO) or a cohort-level TF-gene network (PANDA).

items.prompt: Run community detection on the network my student made. I can't recall whether it connects TFs to genes or genes to genes.
items.deciding: Ask whether the network is bipartite regulator-gene (CONDOR) or gene-gene (unsupported).

items.prompt: Download the physical STRING network for mouse. I might want human later, and I wonder if functional would have been richer, but physical is what I need now.
items.deciding: STRING download, species mouse, network type physical

items.prompt: With my 80 blood samples I could split co-expression into batch and disease contributions, or get a co-expression network for each individual sample. Not sure which suits the study better.
items.deciding: Ask whether the result should be covariate-decomposed co-expression (COBRA) or per-sample co-expression (BONOBO/LIONESS-COEXPRESSION).

items.prompt: Please build a TF and miRNA regulatory network for my samples. The target prior I downloaded may include miRNA-target pairs or may only hold TF-gene motif hits; I couldn't tell from the header.
items.deciding: Ask whether the prior contains miRNA-target pairs (PUMA needs a miRNA-target prior and miRNA list).

items.prompt: I just received expression and methylation tables from the same cohort and I'm new to all this. Help me analyse them?
items.deciding: Ask what question or result the user wants from the two tables.

items.prompt: Get communities and core scores from my existing TF-to-gene bipartite network, one community per node is fine. I wonder whether the modules will line up with known pathways, but that comes afterwards.
items.deciding: CONDOR (pathway curiosity irrelevant)

items.prompt: Please plan and execute the two-omics partial-correlation analysis. The metabolomics samples could be a different set of patients than the RNA ones, unclear to me.
items.deciding: Ask whether the metabolomics and RNA tables come from the same samples (required for DRAGON); must not run.

items.prompt: Fit a time-dynamic model of how regulatory edges change hour by hour across my time course, and tell me which TF causally drives which gene. Unsure about the sampling interval but that's the goal.
items.deciding: Time dynamics and causality are unsupported.

items.prompt: Decompose gene-gene co-expression in my cohort into contributions from batch and disease status, and give me the covariate-adjusted co-expression too. I'm still undecided whether to include age in a follow-up.
items.deciding: COBRA (age follow-up irrelevant)

items.prompt: For my 45 lung samples, would a single aggregate TF-gene network be enough, or do I need a network for every sample so individuals can be compared? Torn between the two.
items.deciding: Ask whether one cohort network (PANDA) or per-sample networks (LIONESS-PANDA) are wanted.

items.prompt: I'd like partial-correlation networks linking my omics layers. The postdoc who left me the data never said whether there are two layers or more, and I haven't opened the folder yet.
items.deciding: Ask how many omics layers there are (DRAGON needs exactly two).
